question: Where are a gallery positioned within 90 kilometers in the direction of southeast from River Edge Bird Sanctuary and Nature Trail, River Edge, NJ?
sql: WITH sanctuary_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%River Edge Bird Sanctuary and Nature Trail%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p, sanctuary_location AS sl WHERE p.tourism = 'gallery' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, sl.geometry::geography, 90000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(sl.geometry, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5;
